paite: Huan gam a ka suahtak un, tuikulh min tuh Malta ahi chih ka theita uhi.
heading: Malta Ah Paul Gul In Atu

paite: Tuikulh gam mite'n asiam theihtawp uh suah in hon na hehpih ua; vuah ahong zuk ziak leh khovot ziak in mei atoh ua, ka vek un hon na kipahpih uhi.
Paul in singlom khat atom a mei ah achih a, asat ziak in gul ahong vakkhia a, akhut a tu in atangden hi.
Tuikulh gam mite'n ganhing akhut a kikhaiden amuh un, "Hiai mi tualthat ahi ding, tuipi a kipan taikhe mahleh diktatna in ahin phalta lou ahi,” achi uhi.
Himahleh ama'n mei ah gul asingkhia a, bangmah achi kei hi.
Amau bel abawk hiam, thakhat a puk pah a si ding in agingta uh; hun sawtpi angak nilouh ua, bangmah achi kei chih atheih un alungsim uh akheng ua, Pathian ahi achi zaw uhi.
Huai mun kiang ah huai tuikulh a hausapa, amin Publias a-om a, huai mi in ahon na kipahpih a, ni thum siamtak in ahon tungsak hi.
heading: Publias Hihdamna

paite: Publias pa khosik leh santen vei in ana lum a; akiang ah Paul alut a, athum a, atung ah akhut koih in ahihdamta hi.
Huai ahihdam khit in tuikulh a midang natna nei peuhmah ahong ua; adam chiatta uhi.
Huai mite'n nakpitak in ahon na pahtawi ua; ka pai ding un long ah ka vante uh ahong koih uhi.
Huan kha thum nung in, Aleksandria kho long, phalbi a tuikulh a omsa, unau phik, Kastor leh Pollux lutang kisuanna long ah ka pai uhi.
heading: Rome Zuan A Zin Zelna

paite: Sairakus khua ka tawn ua huai ah ni thum ka taam uhi.
Huai a kipan ka paikawi ua, Rejiam khua ka tung ua; ni khat nung in sim huih ahong nung a, azing nawn in Puteoli khua ka tung nawn uhi.
Huai ah unaute ka mu ua, akiang uah ni sagih taam ding in ahon khou ua; huchibang in Rome kholam ah ka pai zelta uhi.

Huan unaute'n ka Tanchin uh azaktak un huai a kipan in Appii dawr leh Khualbuk thumte omna chiang ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan ua; Paul in huai mite amuh in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, alungmuang mahmahta hi.
Rome a ka lut un Paul bel avengpa sepaih kiang a amah kia a om aphal uhi.
heading: Rome Khopi Ah Paul

paite: Ni thum nung in, Paul in Juda heutute asamkhawm a; akihoukhawm ua, akiang uah, "Unaute leh mite aw, i pipute dan tung ah bangmah ka hihkhelh louh in leng Jerusalem a kipan in Rome a mite kiang ah ahon hentasak uhi.
Amau ahon etchet khit un, sihna khop hial ka tung ah bangmah amuh louh ziak un khah ahon tum uhi.
Himahleh Judate'n huai asel ziak un Kaisar kiang tun lou thei ka hita kei a; himahleh ka chipihte hekna nei a hih bel ka hi kei hi.
Huai lam thu a noumau hon mu a hon houpih ding in ka hon sam ahi; Israelte lamet thilte toh kisai a khainiang bun ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Na tanchin Judia gam a kipan lai in ka mu kei ua, unau hiai a hong omte kuamah in na tungtang thubuai bangmah apulak kei ua, gen leng agen ngei kei uhi.
Himahleh hiai pawl zaw gam teng ah gensiat ahi ngal ua, nang bangchi in ahia na ngaih chih theih ka utzaw uhi,” achi uhi.

Huan ni achiam ua, huai atunna ah akiang ah mi tampi ahong ua; zing a kipan nitaklam pha in akiang uah huai thu ahilhchian a, Pathian lalgam thu atheisak a, Mosi Dan laibu thu leh zawlneite laibu thu in Jesu lam ah amaute athuzoh zel hi.
Khenkhat in athugen agingta ua, akhen in agingta kei uh.
Huan akituakta kei ua, Paul in thu agen khit in apaikheta uhi. Athugen tuh hiai ahi: Kha Siangthou in zawlnei Isai kam a na pipute uh kiang a athugen adik mahmah ahi chi in:
"Hiai chite kiang ah va gen in, bil in zaw na za na ding ua, angaihna ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh.

Hiai chite lungtang atakta a, abilte uh ana ngong deuh a, amit uh leng asi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un leng athei ding uh, akiheikik ding ua, ke'n ka hihdam kha ding hi," achi, achih pen ahi.
"Huaiziak in Pathian hotdamna thu Zentelte kiang a khakkhiak ahi chih thei un, amau bel ngaih leng angaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi a hiai thute agen khit nung in, Judate apawtkheta ua, alak uah nakpitak in kiselna apiang hi.
Huchi in kum nih vengveng ama inn luahna mun ah Paul a-om a, akiang a hoh peuhmah ana kipahpih hi.
Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hangsantak in Toupa Jesu Khrist thu agen zel a, kuamah in amah akham kei uhi.
